QuestInfo.name: Daily Tempest Soul Link
QuestInfo.0:
Log in for 30 minutes everyday to fill up an Empty Nova Bottle. This will let you pass your reward to the non-Tempest classes on your account.

#bDay 1 - ATT + 10 for 30 min
Day 3 -  1.2x EXP for 30 min
Day 5 - ATT + 20 for 30 min
Day 7 -  1.4x EXP for 30 min
Day 10 -  1.5x EXP for 1 hr
Day 12 -  1.5x EXP & ATT + 30 for 1 hr
Day 14 -  2x EXP & ATT + 30 for 2 hrs
